name: Kulwinder Brar
conditions: Heart failure with reduced ejection fraction

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Osteoarthritis of knee
- Status: Moderate bilateral knee pain, worse on stairs, mild swelling.
- Plan: Continue paracetamol 650 mg SOS, apply topical diclofenac gel BD, start calcium with vitamin D3 1 tablet OD, advise weight-bearing X-ray both knees.

Heart failure with reduced ejection fraction
- Status: NYHA class II, stable, weight 68 kg, waist 78 cm (<80 cm cutoff).
- Plan: Continue sacubitril/valsartan 24/26 mg BD, bisoprolol 2.5 mg OD, spironolactone 25 mg OD, furosemide 40 mg OD, dapagliflozin 10 mg OD, monitor serum creatinine and potassium.

Glaucoma
- Status: Intraocular pressure 22 mmHg OD, 21 mmHg OS on current drops.
- Plan: Continue timolol 0.5% eye drops BD, latanoprost 0.005% eye drops HS, schedule visual field test.

Diet advice
- Breakfast: Whole grain toast with egg white, limited oil.
- Lunch: Mixed vegetable dal, brown rice, portion control.
- Dinner: Light soup, steamed fish, avoid fried foods.

Due: HbA1c not applicable.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Topical diclofenac gel 1% apply BD to affected knees, duration 3 months.
Calcium carbonate 500 mg + vitamin D3 250 IU tablet OD, duration 6 months.

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Serum 25-OH Vitamin D: 18 ng/mL (30-100).
Serum Creatinine: 1.2 mg/dL (0.6-1.1).
Serum Potassium: 4.8 mmol/L (3.5-5.0).
NT-proBNP: 310 pg/mL (<300).
Lipids: Total Cholesterol 190 mg/dL (<200), LDL 115 mg/dL (<100), HDL 48 mg/dL (>40), Triglycerides 140 mg/dL (<150).

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Weight-bearing X-ray both knees: Joint space narrowing grade 2 medially, osteophytes, no fracture. Impression: Moderate osteoarthritis bilateral knees.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Osteoarthritis of knee
- Status: Pain improved slightly after topical diclofenac, still reports discomfort on prolonged walking.
- Plan: Add paracetamol 650 mg TDS SOS if needed, continue calcium+vit D3, reinforce quadriceps exercises, consider intra‑articular hyaluronate if no further improvement.

Heart failure with reduced ejection fraction
- Status: Weight 67 kg, waist 77 cm, no dyspnea at rest, mild fatigue on exertion.
- Plan: Up‑titrate bisoprolol to 5 mg OD, continue other HF meds, check electrolytes in 2 weeks.

Glaucoma
- Status: IOP 21 mmHg OD, 20 mmHg OS.
- Plan: Continue current drops, schedule visual field test in 3 months.

Diet advice
- Breakfast: Oatmeal with skim milk, no added sugar.
- Lunch: Chapati with vegetable curry, small portion rice.
- Dinner: Grilled chicken, steamed vegetables, avoid sugary desserts.

Due: HbA1c not applicable.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Bisoprolol 5 mg tablet OD, duration 3 months.
All other medications unchanged.

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Echocardiogram: LVEF 38% (baseline 35%), NYHA class II.
Serum Creatinine: 1.1 mg/dL (0.6-1.1).
Serum Potassium: 4.6 mmol/L (3.5-5.0).
NT-proBNP: 260 pg/mL (<300).

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Echocardiogram (transthoracic): Left ventricular end‑diastolic diameter 5.6 cm, LVEF 38%, mild mitral regurgitation, no pulmonary hypertension. Impression: Stable HFrEF, slight improvement in EF.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Right knee pain increased over past week, especially climbing stairs; using extra paracetamol. Also noticing occasional blurred vision in left eye, worried glaucoma drops may be causing irritation.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow‑up visit booked for 2026-03-10 at 10:30 AM with Dr Karthik Hegde (D04).

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Osteoarthritis of knee
- Status: Pain moderate, reports difficulty with prolonged standing; X‑ray shows unchanged joint space.
- Plan: Continue paracetamol SOS, topical diclofenac BD, add glucosamine 1500 mg OD for trial 3 months, reinforce physiotherapy.

Heart failure with reduced ejection fraction
- Status: Weight 66 kg, waist 76 cm, no orthopnea, NT‑proBNP 240 pg/mL.
- Plan: Continue bisoprolol 5 mg OD, sacubitril/valsartan, spironolactone, furosemide, dapagliflozin; check renal function and K+ in 4 weeks.

Glaucoma
- Status: IOP 20 mmHg OD, 19 mmHg OS, mild conjunctival redness noted.
- Plan: Switch latanoprost to preservative‑free formulation, continue timolol, review in 6 weeks.

Diet advice
- Breakfast: Idli with sambar, minimal oil.
- Lunch: Wheat rotis with leafy greens, small rice portion.
- Dinner: Fish curry, avoid deep‑fried snacks.

Due: HbA1c not applicable.
